title: Settings, Invite and the Product brief read plainly
description: At 1280px and 390px: Settings → Delivery shows no graphyard.json, delivery.applications or Mode row and reads 'No app to preview yet.' with no app declared; Setup shows no 'Done' badge and no 'Coordinator', its loop step reading 'Mainworks is handing out work' (the product's name since GY-3572); Agents has one fold named 'Advanced' and no first-run Setup link; the Invite dialog's first field is 'Name or email' with no Funnel or Tailscale text before Invite; a seeded brief renders its headings and list items as such, no line starting with '#' or '- '; nothing scrolls sideways.
